title: deprea xalapensis
intro: Deprea xalapensis, commonly known as Xalapense or Mexican snuff, is a plant species in the Solanaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including health benefits such as treating respiratory issues, fever reduction, and as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Deprea xalapensis include expectorant, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in treating coughs, colds, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include tropane alkaloids, such as scopolamine and hyoscyamine, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
